select * from ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE >= #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE >= #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} THEN '01' WHEN ((ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE}) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is null) or (PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null and PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE <#{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE}) THEN '02' WHEN (ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE}) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null and PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE >= #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} THEN '03'
ELSE NULL END AS issueStage, PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS as issueStatus, PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodMarketId, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, PRODUCT.REGIST_ORG as registOrg, PRODUCT.ISSUER as issuer , PRODUCT.ISSUE_TYPE as issueType, ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS as issueClass, ISSUE.TENDER_TYPE as tenderType, ISSUE.TENDER_TARGET as tenderTarget, ISSUE.ISSUE_EDATE as issueDate, PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE as listingDate, PRODUCT_ADD.APPEAR_MARKET_ID as appearMarketId, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR as appearMarketAbbr, PRODUCT.VDATE as vdate, PRODUCT.MDATE as mdate, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_9 as type9, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_10 as type10, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_11 as type11, PRODUCT.COUPON_SPECIES as couponSpecies, PRODUCT.CCY as ccy, PRODUCT.ISSUE_PRICE as issuePrice, ISSUE.INT_TYPE as intType, PRODUCT.REMARK as remark, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE ISSUE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ISSUE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID AND PRODUCT_TYPE.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO ON PRODUCT.ISSUER = CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID where PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02}) and (PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS not in (#{ISSUE_STATUS_02}) or PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS is null) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is null and PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE=#{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) t where t.issueStage=#{issueStage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
